title: Microsoft Purview: network DLP for server and VM traffic through Azure Firewall
summary: Hold: Microsoft now publishes the Azure Firewall integration's Purview licensing requirements, contrary to the briefing's budgeting guidance. Mapped accounts need Purview E5 or equivalent per-seat licences, and Purview pay-as-you-go setup is not required. The briefing also incorrectly leaves the documented B2B guest exclusion unconfirmed for this integration.
